GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: got leg up momentarily barriers, passed vet Jumped Fast Settled Down hdy 2 Lengths Two Wide Good Pace home turn 2 Lengths stuck on well on brutal tempo 6len to 3rd Went very well. # chased hot speed
Jumped Ok Ridden Along to get 2nd 3l on a tear away pace Straightened Up 2nd Outside 1 length Kept Going Soundly but No Match for quietr rides # good on pace
jumped awkwardly Caught Wide Went Forward led narrowly rail Straightened Up 2-3l in front Kept Going Far Too Well # led/never in danger
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Began awkwardly, shifted out and bumped another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well Settled Down second 2wide 1 length joined in Straightening Up but Quickly Under Pressure couldn't finish off , new stable # on pace/faded 150
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider explained her instructions were to settle where comfortable. Has respiratory abnormality and as such did not want to restrain. Laid in.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Began fairly. Not pushed early & raced Worse than midfield Two Wide (8L from lead). Stayed same until chasing 3 Wide @ 550m. Struggling Four Wide (9L from lead) on home turn. Gave ground in straight. Rider - unusual resp. noise/vetted clear. # Always struggling.
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Rider reported that he was instructed to take up a forward position, however when the tempo was fast in the early stages his mount did not show sufficient speed and settled further back.  He stated that his mount failed to respond to his riding when placed under pressure and the only explanation he could offer was that it made an unusual respiratory noise during the race. A post-race veterinary examination revealed no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Bit Slow Out Settled Down Mid Field Inside 5-6l struggling Turn dropped out # lame
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Eased down over the final 250m. Rider reported that the mare felt amiss in its action. Post-race vet exam – lame in the off-fore leg. A veterinary clearance will be required prior to racing again.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay settled down fifth Wide no cover 3l much the same turning for home kept on one pace # Wide no cover/even
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Raced wide without cover from the 700m.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Fast , Crossed Two Wide Slight Lead @ 800m. Kept Coming led x 2-3L 500m. spent force when Headed @ 200m, Couldn'T Go On (vetted - nothing amiss) # weak once headed
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Performed below market expectations. Rider reported that his mount travelled well in the lead, however failed to respond to his riding and was disappointing. Added in his opinion the mare would appreciate tracks with more give. Post-race vet exam – no abnormalities.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: jumped Just Ok , Settled Down Inside 6th Just 3 Lengths @ 700m. fanned off fence Straightening Up . seemed to mostly have enough room, Just Held Ground . Tight near line # Prefer To See Again
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Slow to begin. Laid in under pressure in the straight and proved difficult to ride out in normal manner. Approaching the winning post struck across the nose by the whip of another rider. Tactics queried. R instructed to lead, slow to begin and crossed, obliged to race without cover. 400m observed leaders Bronco Revolution and Miss Lottie shift in, and he felt that his best option obtain clear running was to shift to the outside however miss lottie shifted back out and the run he was attempting became tight and mount commened to lay in went to the line no fully tested.
